title: Ubiquiti Unifi Cloud Gateway Fiber (UCG-Fiber) $429, U7 Lite Wi-Fi Access Point $159 + Delivery ($0 VIC, WA C&C/ in-Store) @ PLE
body:
Deal: Ubiquiti Unifi Cloud Gateway Fiber (UCG-Fiber) $429, U7 Lite Wi-Fi Access Point $159 + Delivery ($0 VIC, WA C&C/ in-Store) @ PLE

[dealinator] Nice one, this might be the price that breaks me
[willyroo] UCG Max for $399 is also a good price if you want onboard storage for NVRs…
[sssbp] UCG Fiber has been a beautiful purchase and couldn't be more happier with it
I have a U6 Pro, a U6 Mesh and 3x g6 instants connected to it
All running smoothly
UniFi OS v6 and network v10 has given considerable improvement in ram usage
Hovers between 70-80%
Highly recommended
Great find OP
[unstungbee] Bought this exact combo about a year ago, couldn’t be happier. Great for a small home security as well if you add a POE switch.
I would highly recommend this for anyone wanting to get their feet wet in some more in depth networking controls. Or anyone looking at do any at home self hosting, it all starts with a solid network.
[mahd-mahn] Don't be me. Be careful. UXG != UCG.
If you are buying your first Ubiquiti device you want the UCG (as listed in this post) which includes the unifi Network utility on the router to configure the router. If you don't get the UCG (like me) you need to either buy a device or self host the Network app on your NAS or something.
(profanity) their product naming SUCKS. I'm super careful too but this bit me.
[Notbigdeal] I picked up the ucg-ultra for 169 @amazon instead. Who needs 10gb?
[mahdoo] There's a lot more differences between the ultra and fiber other than 10gbps support.
the ultra doesn't even have PoE.
